attributes.title: 2027 UVA Advanced Practice Conference (APOGEE)
attributes.summary:
UVA Health's 2027 Advanced Practice Conference, branded APOGEE, runs February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Omni Hotel in Charlottesville, Virginia. It is meant for NPs, PAs and other advanced practice clinicians in inpatient, outpatient and community settings.

Beyond clinical topics such as nicotine harm across the lifespan and care transitions for complex patients, much of the program deals with APP careers: hospital administration, research, leadership across health systems and teaching. The activity carries 12.75 ANCC contact hours and 12.75 AAPA Category 1 CME credits. Two-day registration is $275 until January 10, 2027 and $325 afterwards; registration closes January 31 and walk-ins are not accepted.
